understanding.goal_understanding: Reach the goal gem tile marked + in each level while avoiding spike tiles, ultimately completing the game.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Movement is horizontal via MOVE_LEFT or MOVE_RIGHT, after which gravity carries the player until landing on a solid tile, hitting a hazard, or reaching the goal. Gravity direction determines whether the player falls toward smaller or larger y-values. CLICK removes a targeted clickable breakable tile without changing the player’s position or advancing the rising-platform timer. Landing on spikes ends the attempt; each level allows two attempts, and UNDO reverts the previous action.
